source: layerEffects class of Photoshop.exe terminology + live set/read-back of each effect (tools/ps/harvest_more.py, probe.py)

items.name: Drop Shadow

invoke.ps_dom: set layer property layerEffects.dropShadow (object class dropShadow)

items.requires: layer that is not the locked Background
items.evidence: effect set on a pixel layer with only {enabled: true}; the layer's layerEffects read back gives every key Photoshop filled in (defaults); min/max = value kept after setting 1e6 / 1e6+7 and negatives (clamp seen twice); other keys declared in the terminology class
